items.title: Bob Haggart interviewed by Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995
items.q: Don’t try to make it, as Bobby Hackett says, “You don’t try to make a home run every time, just get on base.”

ctx.x: Yeah, it’s like four voices. And they don’t get in each other’s way too much. And again if those guys are going to play they’ve got to listen to each other. Don’t try to make it, as Bobby Hackett says, “You don’t try to make a home run every time, just get on base.”
